labels: Back flat on the pad, brace

text.setup: Back and shoulders flat against the pads, feet shoulder-width in the middle of the platform. Release the safeties.
cues: Bend your knees and sit straight down the line of the sled.
Go as deep as you can with your back still flat on the pad.
Drive through your whole foot back to the top, without locking the knees hard.
mistakes: Hips peeling off the pad at the bottom.
Cutting depth short as the weight goes up.

variants.machine: Feet higher on the platform shift work to the glutes; lower and closer, to the quads.
variants.plate_loaded_machine: Feet higher on the platform shift work to the glutes; lower and closer, to the quads.
